report.skipped.tip: Why a ticked shape was not written.

report.stillSkin: still clipping into the skin at full weight: {0}

window.title: Blendshape Transfer
window.exitPlayMode: Exit Play Mode to use Blendshape Transfer.
header.language.tip: The language of this window. It is kept between Unity sessions.
section.garments.tip: The body, and the garments that get its shapes, inner layer first.
garments.body.tip: The avatar's body Skinned Mesh Renderer whose blendshapes are carried onto the garments.
garments.list.tip: Drag rows to set the layer order: a garment is kept outside the ones above it in this list. Click a row to show its settings and shapes below.
garments.addSelected.tip: Add the Skinned Mesh Renderers selected in the Hierarchy.
garments.addSaved.tip: Add every renderer of this avatar, inactive ones too, that already has a transfer in BlendshapeTransferGenerated.
garments.noneSelected: None of the selected objects is a new garment.
garments.noneSaved: No other renderer of this avatar has a saved transfer.
garments.read.tip: Read the body and the garments in their current pose. Takes about 6 s per garment; Transfer needs it.
garments.readAgain.tip: Read the meshes again, for example after changing the pose or a garment's mesh.
garments.reloadDropped: A script reload dropped the read meshes.
garments.gone: The body or a garment is gone; read the meshes again.
garments.reimported: A mesh that was read was imported again; read again to use it.
garments.poseChanged: The pose or a shape weight changed since the meshes were read. Read them again: until then Transfer and All again are off.
garments.preset.tip: The garment's preset; Custom when its settings were changed by hand.
garments.upToDate: Up to date: the output was written from these settings and meshes.
garments.stale: Needs a transfer: no output yet, or something it depends on changed.
bottom.transfer.tip: Compute and write the garments that need it, inner layer first. Up-to-date garments are skipped.
bottom.allAgain.tip: Compute and write every garment, also those that look up to date.
bottom.save.tip: Put the generated meshes on the renderers. Available when every garment is up to date.
bottom.sync.tip: Add MA Blendshape Sync bindings so the garments follow the body's shape weights in game.
status.restored: {0} is back on its original mesh; the generated asset stays on disk.
section.settings.tip: How the shapes are carried onto this garment. A change makes it and the garments above it need a transfer.
settings.preset.tip: The garment's current preset. Picking one replaces every setting below; Custom means they were changed by hand.
preset.Tight.desc: Tight: fabric that fits the skin.
preset.Loose.desc: Loose: loose fabric over the skin.
preset.Skirt.desc: Skirt: a skirt or dress whose fabric hangs between the legs.
preset.Rigid.desc: Rigid: hard parts that do not bend (armour, buckles).
settings.saveAs.tip: Save these settings as a preset asset to use on other garments.
settings.mode.tip: Surface: follows the skin point under each vertex (tight fabric). Blend: averages the skin around it (loose fabric). Field: averages a wide area (fabric hanging between the legs). Hybrid: Surface near the skin, Field farther away (dresses).
settings.blendRadius.tip: How far around each vertex Blend averages the skin.
settings.fieldRadius.tip: How far Field averages the skin; larger is smoother between the legs.
settings.smoothing.tip: How many times the motion is averaged with neighbouring vertices. More is smoother; separate parts lying on the fabric ride on it.
settings.antiClip.tip: Push the garment out where a shape would push it into the skin or a lower garment.
settings.clearance.tip: The gap anti-clip keeps, never more than the garment's own gap at rest; over skin a shape moves, at least 0.2 mm.
settings.advanced.tip: Distances, filters, rigid parts, garments not worn together, refit.
settings.falloffFull.tip: Vertices this close to the skin move fully.
settings.falloffZero.tip: Vertices this far from the skin do not move; between the two the effect fades.
settings.hybridNear.tip: Closer to the skin than this, Hybrid uses Surface only.
settings.hybridFar.tip: Farther than this, Hybrid uses Field only. It also widens the search for the skin in every mode.
settings.boneFilter.tip: Take motion only from skin on the same or a neighbouring bone, so a sleeve next to the torso follows the arm.
settings.sideFilter.tip: Take motion only from skin on the garment's side, so a sleeve around a thickening arm grows instead of cancelling.
settings.rigidSize.tip: Separate parts no larger than this keep their shape (buttons, rivets).
settings.notWornWith.tip: Lower garments never shown together with this one (shorts a toggle swaps for this skirt). Anti-clip ignores them.
settings.refit.tip: Forget the body weights this garment was fitted at, so the next read takes the current ones.
refit.title: Refit garment
refit.text:
{0} fits the body weights it was first transferred at. Refit clears the weights recorded for this garment; the next read takes the current ones, unless another garment of the read holds a record for the same shape.

The read meshes are dropped; read them again. Undo restores the records only before the next read.
settings.presetNameTaken: "{0}" is a built-in preset name; pick another file name.
settings.presetNotAPreset: {0} is not a preset and is not overwritten; pick another file name.
section.shapes.tip: The body's shapes to carry onto this garment, in the body's order, grouped by its separator shapes.
shapes.search.tip: Show the shapes whose name contains this text, whether they reach the garment or not.
shapes.reachOnly: Only shapes that reach this garment
shapes.reachOnly.tip: Hide unticked shapes that move the skin under this garment by less than 0.05 mm.
shapes.group.tip: The shapes under one separator shape of the body: ticked of shown.
shapes.groupTick: Tick or untick every shown shape of the group.
shapes.reach.tip: How far the shape moves the skin under this garment.
shapes.baseOffset.tip: The weight the garment was fitted at (W₀); the garment gets the matching offset at weight 0.
shapes.onGarment: The garment already has its author's shape of this name; it is kept unless Overwrite is on.
shapes.overwrite.tip: Replace the author's shape with a transferred one.
section.result: 4. Result: up to date {0} of {1}, with warnings {2}
section.result.tip: What the last transfer of each garment did.
result.restore.tip: Put the source mesh back and remove the Sync bindings this tool added. The generated asset stays on disk.
result.copy.tip: Copy the whole report in this language to the clipboard.
tab.transfer.tip: Read the meshes, choose shapes and settings, transfer and save.
tab.edit.tip: Preview a shape in the Scene View and check the result.
edit.shape.tip: The body shape the Scene View shows. Only shapes ticked on at least one garment are listed.
edit.weight.tip: The weight the preview shows; the renderers' own weights do not change.
edit.noShapes: No garment has a shape ticked. Tick shapes on the Transfer tab.
edit.showClipping.tip: Red dots: a garment inside the skin, or skin through the garment. Orange dots: a garment inside a lower layer. At the weight shown.
edit.clippingCounts: clipping into the skin: {0} · into a lower layer: {1}
edit.hideOthers.tip: Hides the avatar's other renderers (hair, head, accessories) while the preview runs.
edit.layers.tip: The eye shows or hides a mesh in the preview; clicking a garment makes it the current one.
edit.eye: Show or hide this mesh in the preview
edit.label: Blendshape Transfer: {0} {1:0}
edit.poseChangedShort: The pose or a weight changed since the read.
edit.endPreview.tip: Shows the real renderers again and switches the window to the Transfer tab.
